newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Comalco to move HQ to Brisbane.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Comalco to move HQ to Brisbane.

text.p: Aluminium producer Comalco Ltd said on Monday it would move its corporate and smelting headquarters to Brisbane later in 1997.
"Comalco has made a decision to move its corporate and smelting headquartrs to Birisbane later this year," Comalco chief executive Terry Palmer told a news conference.
"Over 70 percent of Comalco's assets are located in Queensland and that proportion is growing so this is a natural and logical move," he said.
Palmer said the move completed the company's migration to Queensland after shifting its minerals and alumina business headquarters in 1995.
